item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence that Lula expanded services and equal-opportunity institutions in 2024, but much of the best material is official-government reporting rather than independent evaluation. The weakest part of the evidence is durability beyond Lula’s personal rule: 2024 sources show institution-building intent and some standing mechanisms, but they cannot prove those gains will survive a future administration. The most reliable negative evidence is not that Lula tried to block opportunity, but that baseline constraints remained severe in remote Amazon areas, police abuse persisted, and fiscal pressure could
